facet_coverage.label: Public Codexware
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Inspectable individual–institutional public-data analysis with deterministic operations and evidence export
facet_coverage.release_observation: No Codexware release package was found in the public repository at this baseline.
open_gaps: Locate current in-flight implementation and verify build/rights status
Confirm first dataset and reproducible analysis contract
Publish only with explicit source, license, privacy and review clearance
Connected GitHub repository and branch discovery did not resolve the current Codexware MVP implementation; no absence or production-readiness conclusion follows.

facet_coverage.label: Paper Checking
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Paper claim–dependency–evidence inspection with explicit missing proof obligations
facet_coverage.release_observation: No paper-checking release or completed service pilot is established by the public repository.
open_gaps: Verify pilot execution and independent benchmarks from owning source
Select a rights-cleared paper and evidence packet
Separate mechanical checks from mathematical and scientific validity

facet_coverage.label: Consequential Systems & Repair
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Trace bug report → data invariant → business rule → institutional constraint → verified repair
facet_coverage.release_observation: A public case release with tests and consequence witnesses is not established at this baseline.
open_gaps: Choose a sanitized, consented, attributable case
Bind each repair to original evidence and a reproducible check
Prohibit unsupported claims of full institutional closure

Viability Control Theory for Wicked Systems: formalize contested objectives, viability constraints, interventions, affected-party agency and counterexamples; establish prior-art comparisons before claiming novelty.
Constructive Humanist Agentics: reconcile the July 2026 working synthesis and current agency doctrine with accountable ownership, measured agency preservation and review status.

facet_coverage.label: Software Before Code
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Requirements, invariants and exception contracts before implementation
facet_coverage.release_observation: A versioned public project package has not been identified for Software Before Code.
open_gaps: Recover current definition and owner-reviewed examples
Compare to established design-by-contract/formal-methods practice
Show measurable value without implying universal novelty

facet_coverage.label: Boundary First UX
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: One semantic object across world, analytical and timeline views, preserving identity and evidence
facet_coverage.release_observation: No versioned public BFUX demonstration package is identified in this repository.
open_gaps: Recover canonical flagship and current view contracts
Test cross-view identity and accessibility
Distinguish aesthetic visualization from experimentally validated UX advantage

facet_coverage.label: Mathematics, Physics & Computation
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Explore typed n-ball construction, slicing, classical recurrence and representation-loss counterexample
facet_coverage.release_observation: A public educational n-ball package exists; it is not an original theorem, physical validation or peer-reviewed research result.
open_gaps: Reconcile recent diagram and type-tree sources with current owner evidence
Maintain separate mathematics, computation and physics claim standards
Recover original geometric construction files only after rights/provenance review

facet_coverage.label: Economic Water Model
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Compare monetary flow, gate capacity, jointly reachable allocations and access constraints in synthetic examples
facet_coverage.release_observation: No public economic-model executable package or independently reviewable results are identified here.
open_gaps: Recover rights-cleared synthetic fixtures and exact executable version
Validate joint versus isolated capacity in the reproducibility package
Avoid treating synthetic feasibility as empirical economic proof

facet_coverage.label: AI Understanding, Explainability, Alignment & Governance
facet_coverage.candidate_demo: Continuation-sufficiency collision, explanation-versus-evidence audit, or inspectable delegated-agency review
facet_coverage.release_observation: This public repository does not establish a general explanation of why LLMs work or a validated general AI alignment solution.
open_gaps: Separate mechanism explanation, interpretability, alignment and governance evidence
Recover falsifiable benchmarks and matched baselines
Review delegated-authority examples and exclude unsupported safety certification claims
